No Capcom character geometry, textures, logos, names, faces, costumes, or proprietary details may enter LuHm runtime or public production assets.

pirateDaddiesTranslation.familyHierarchy: Use deliberate height, posture, costume-volume, and silhouette contrast to make the elder/matriarch figure dominate a group shot without cloning the reference.
pirateDaddiesTranslation.sisterDifferentiation: Shared family design language must not collapse Lum, Urd, Belldandy, and Skuld into the same face/body/costume.
pirateDaddiesTranslation.lodLesson: Preserve identity silhouette at multiple triangle budgets; build original LODs from LuHm masters.
pirateDaddiesTranslation.materialLesson: Separate readable large-shape costume design from fine ornament so characters remain identifiable at distance.
pirateDaddiesTranslation.bodyMutationLesson: Use the reference envelope to test tall/hourglass/mature and slimmer/younger-adult archetype extremes without importing protected proportions one-to-one.
pirateDaddiesTranslation.runtimeLesson: All final characters remain original LuHm geometry driven by GODDESS_MORPH_PRESETS_V1 and Godot runtime morph/secondary-motion systems.
